evaluation_basis: Assessed for multi-seed stability, paired moving-block inference, FDR, universe quality and regime robustness.
original_objective: Stress v0.10 learned models and baselines with multiple seeds, bootstrap/FDR and regime diagnostics before any promotion.

engineering_result.summary: The final run excluded stablecoin bases after an earlier USDG eligibility defect and completed all deterministic, discovery, robustness and artifact checks.

scientific_result.summary: Learned challengers were materially inferior to Ichimoku; no FDR-significant learned edge or sufficient regime stability existed.

economic_result.summary: Ichimoku median +39.69%, Sharpe 1.752, MDD -34.54%; Logistic -27.28%, Sharpe -1.090. Logistic-minus-Ichimoku mean CI was entirely below zero.

limitations: Performance concentrated in HIGH_VOL and TREND_DOWN
Regime gate would be post-hoc on this sample
No external holdout in this stage
contribution_to_next_version: Froze the regime hypothesis and required v0.12 external derivatives/Ichimoku feature-family validation on an untouched domain.
